info.title: Proctor Server API
info.description: The reviewed public HTTP contract. Coverage currently includes Academic Unit, Institution, Programme, Programme Level, Academic Period, and Class capabilities and expands incrementally with each migrated capability.

patch.summary: Update or reparent an Academic Unit

get.summary: List an Academic Unit's direct children
List or search Programmes owned by an Academic Unit

post.summary: Create a Programme owned by an Academic Unit

patch.summary: Update a Programme without changing its Academic Unit owner

delete.summary: Archive a Programme that has no active Programme Levels

get.summary: List or search Programme Levels owned by a Programme

post.summary: Create a Programme Level owned by a Programme

patch.summary: Update a Programme Level without changing its Programme owner

delete.summary: Archive a Programme Level that has no active Classes

get.summary: List or search institution-defined Academic Periods

patch.summary: Update an Academic Period without changing its Institution owner

delete.summary: Archive an Academic Period with no active Classes or enrollments

get.summary: Search Classes owned by an Academic Unit
List Classes for a Programme Level

post.summary: Create a Class for a Programme Level and Academic Period

get.summary: Get a Class using exact Class scope authorization

patch.summary: Update a Class and optionally move its parent references

delete.summary: Archive a Class with no active members or role bindings

bearerAuth.description: A Proctor session access credential or Personal Access Token, subject to the route's x-proctor-auth requirement.

sessionCookie.name: PROCTOR_ACCESS
sessionCookie.description: The host-only HttpOnly browser session access cookie.

csrfToken.name: X-Proctor-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Required with the session cookie for state-changing requests.
